'''Kels''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the chief engineer aboard the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'', a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the ''Dorin's Sky'' was boarded by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and Kels was [[Death/Legends|killed]] defending the engineering deck.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Engineer Kels appears as one of the bosses in the Boarding Party Flashpoint appearing in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
